name: Exit & Liquidity {OS}
tagline: Prepare, time and run a liquidity event.

commands.name: /exit-readiness
commands.does: Score sellability against what a buyer will test, and classify every gap as paperwork, value or structural.
commands.returns: A readiness score and a gap list, each gap classified with an owner and a date.

commands.name: /exit-index
commands.does: Build the diligence readiness index: the buyer request list with exists, location, owner and state per line.
commands.returns: The index, the count of absent lines, and the absences blocking the earliest gate.

commands.name: /exit-value
commands.does: Produce an internal working valuation range from the operator's own numbers under stated assumptions.
commands.returns: A low, base and high, the assumption under each, and the sensitivities. Labelled internal, never a formal valuation or fairness opinion.

commands.name: /exit-acquirers
commands.does: Map who plausibly buys this asset, why, what they have bought before, and the contact state per name.
commands.returns: The acquirer landscape with a stated reason to buy and a recorded contact state per candidate. Contacts nobody.

commands.name: /exit-structure
commands.does: Write the structure preference and the walk-away before any offer exists, and assemble the tax question pack.
commands.returns: The preference, marked provisional until the tax professional has reviewed it, plus the questions for that review.

commands.name: /exit-questions
commands.does: Assemble a question pack for a named adviser: lawyer, accountant or tax professional.
commands.returns: The questions, the documents each needs attached, and the decision each unblocks.

commands.name: /exit-release
commands.does: Request approval to release one document to one named outside party, per document and per recipient.
commands.returns: The approval request, and on approval an append only disclosure log entry naming document, recipient, date, approving human and confidentiality agreement.

commands.name: /exit-timeline
commands.does: Show the exit timeline, its gates, and which gate is currently blocking.
commands.returns: The gates in order, what each requires, and the blocking item with its owner.

commands.name: /exit-obligations
commands.does: Track what survives the close: earn-out milestones, escrow releases, transition services, restrictive covenants.
commands.returns: Each obligation with its date, owner and release condition, and what falls due in the requested window.

commands.name: /exit-proceeds
commands.does: Hand the expected proceeds range to Wealth {OS}, net of the deductions this OS can identify.
commands.returns: The range, plus the deductions it cannot identify named as open questions for the accountant and tax professional.

requires_human_approval_for: releasing any document, number or summary to any outside party, approved per document and per recipient
opening, populating or granting access to a data room
recording a structure preference as settled, which additionally requires review by a tax professional
presenting an internal valuation range as anything other than internal
emitting exit.structure.proposed to Ownership {OS}, since it touches the legal shape of what the operator owns
contacting, or drafting under the operator's name for, any named acquirer
signing, transferring, receiving or moving money, which this OS never executes
